commands.run.gone.text: That command is no longer there.
commands.run.gone.note: An error: the user ran one of their commands by hand (Settings → Commands, or the command palette), but it was deleted meanwhile.

commands.run.testCopy.text: This is a test copy of Combwork: it doesn't run your commands.
commands.run.testCopy.note: An error in a test copy of Hive (one the developers' tests start): it never runs the user's own commands.
